report.summary: daedalus/structcore/perfile.py: Pure, picklable, parallelizable per-file analysis functions and data structures that are the per-file half of index building, including FileAnalysis dataclass, analyze_file for single file analysis, and analyze_chunk for batched worker entry.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/perfile.py|Pure: same inputs -> same outputs, no I/O, no globals.
CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/perfile.py|Workers must not re-enter the single-flight build lock.
todos: daedalus/structcore/perfile.py|constant|ANALYSIS_VERSION|Version identifier for FileAnalysis schema, incremented when meaning of rows changes.
daedalus/structcore/perfile.py|dataclass|FileAnalysis|Data container for per-file analysis results including metrics, units, imports, type facts.
daedalus/structcore/perfile.py|function|analyze_file|Pure function that analyzes a single file given text and language spec, returns FileAnalysis.
daedalus/structcore/perfile.py|function|analyze_chunk|Worker entry point for batch analysis of files, tags results with original index for order restoration.
